pagerbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty triggered: svc=inference-serving-prod alert=kv_cache_memory_pressure severity=critical — p95 latency spiking, pod restarts observed. Paging oncall @alex.

alex: on it. grabbing metrics now — can anyone confirm which cluster/region?

maria: seeing the same in us-west-2-prod. memory on model-serving pods climbed from 30%->92% within 8m. evictions at ~1769504280.

chen: quick note: we just rolled batch-scheduler v2.3.1 (deploy abc123) 12m ago to reduce token-level cost via continuous prefetching. suspicious.

alex: ok hold there. if prefetching is over-aggressive it can inflate KV cache working set. set mitigation plan: 1) disable continuous prefetch on live (feature flag) 2) scale up min replicas to avoid thrash 3) run controlled warmup.

jordan: I can flip the flag. which toggle? `BATCH_PREFETCH_ENABLED` on k8s configmap `model-runtime-config`.

alex: yes. jordan, patch to `false` and rollout to us-west-2-prod. keep rollout maxUnavailable=0.

jordan: executing now. command:```kubectl -n runtime patch configmap model-runtime-config -p '{"data":{"BATCH_PREFETCH_ENABLED":"false"}}'``` rolling update in progress.

infra-bot: rollout job started for deployment/model-runtime (us-west-2-prod). 3/12 pods updated.

maria: traffic still elevated — we have a feedback loop: prefetch increases concurrency -> more tails queued -> HPA sees CPU jump -> scales up -> each new replica builds big KV cache -> memory climbs -> evictions -> requests requeue -> repeat. We're getting thrash.

alex: good description. immediate extra step: set HPA minReplicas=6 (was 2) and bump scaleDown stabilization to 10m, so autoscaler doesn't overshoot while caches stabilize. jordan, apply HPA change.

jordan: applied: `kubectl -n runtime patch hpa model-runtime-hpa --type='merge' -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":6,"behavior":{"scaleDown":{"stabilizationWindowSeconds":600}}}}'`

chen: also recommend temporary reduction of batch size to limit per-pod KV growth. change `MAX_BATCH_TOKENS=1024` -> `256`. That should limit memory per replica.

jordan: patching configmap again for token cap.```kubectl -n runtime patch configmap model-runtime-config -p '{"data":{"MAX_BATCH_TOKENS":"256"}}'``` rolling update continues.

infra-bot: configmap change triggered new rollout; 8/12 pods updated.

maria: early numbers: pod memory usage trending down on updated pods, request 5xx rate dropping from 3.2% -> 0.9%. p95 latency slowly improving.

alex: good. start customer impact assessment: which tenants saw errors? mari, pull customer-facing logs and list top 5 by error volume. include any enterprise customers with SLA risk.

maria: pulling: top impacted tenants: acme-inc (429s & 503s), dataflow.ai (timeout bursts), small apps with long-context prompts saw highest error rate. Reached out to SEs for acme; creating incident ticket INC-2026-274.

alex: note for postmortem: root cause suspicion is prefetch policy combined with no KV eviction cap + aggressive HPA defaults. Action items now: revert prefetcher heuristics, add KV size guardrail (soft and hard caps), update HPA behavior to include cooldowns, add a synthetic warmup job to prefill caches gracefully.

chen: logging note: add metric `kv_cache_bytes_per_replica` + alert when >70% of pod memory. Also add an eval to our release gate: if v2.3.1 increases average KV by >25% in canary then block.

jordan: rollout complete in us-west-2-prod. all pods stable. infra-bot confirms no new evictions in last 5m.

alex: thanks everyone. paging summary for incident channel: we mitigated by disabling prefetch, capping batch tokens, and stabilizing HPA. Follow-ups: RCA, config hard caps, release-gate for prefetch heuristics, and customer outreach for acme-inc. I'll hand off to SRE oncall for post-incident tracking. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Incident INC-2026-274 created and assigned to `sre-oncall`. Updates will be appended.

maria: adding runbook note: when you see KV cache spike after batch changes -> immediate steps = toggle prefetch off, cap batch tokens to 256, set HPA minReplicas higher, monitor evictions for 10m.

chen: will follow up with a lightweight test harness to stress prefetch locally against small memory VMs before any rollout.

alex: closing loop here in eng-oncall; if anything new pops, re-open thread. otherwise we'll move to postmortem draft tomorrow.

jordan: :white_check_mark: thanks all.
